# Caleb Stacy

Caleb Stacy is a senior content designer with twelve years across product and education. His work
spans product strategy, interaction language, onboarding, experimentation, content standards,
terminology, taxonomy, and AI-assisted content systems.

Canonical portfolio: https://calebstacy.com/
Resume: https://calebstacy.com/Caleb-Stacy-Resume.pdf
Contact: calebstacy@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/calebstacy

## Selected work

### Verso

Verso combined a governed content-design agent, an eleven-dimension language measurement engine,
and a structured content index. It routed each claim to the strongest computation it could honestly
support: deterministic checks for determinate rules, measured evidence for observable language
patterns, and explicit human review where the evidence did not determine one answer.

Portfolio route: https://calebstacy.com/#verso

### Exact-output language proof

Caleb built an independent proof of one language-governance mechanism using public Netflix shelf
titles. A person supplies `Classic Anime Films`; an adopted demo profile returns REVIEW; the agent
revises one term to `Classic Anime Movies`; code checks that exact revision again before the final
title can appear. The proof keeps the responsibilities separate: a person adopts the profile, the
agent revises, code verifies the final string, and a person still decides which title is right.

This is independent work derived only from public shelf titles. It is not affiliated with Netflix
and does not claim to reproduce Netflix policy or internal systems.

Proof route: https://calebstacy.com/netflix-shelves/
Evidence paper: https://calebstacy.com/netflix-shelves/evidence.html
Recorded exchange: https://calebstacy.com/netflix-shelves/recorded_agent_trace.json

### VR NUX

A just-in-time new-user education strategy replaced a fourteen-plus-lesson first run in Meta
Horizon VR. The work improved onboarding completion, weekly active use, and new-user retention.

Portfolio route: https://calebstacy.com/#vr-education

### Horizon Portals

A proximity-based information architecture let people understand a destination before stepping
through it. The work shipped in Meta Horizon and was introduced at Meta Connect 2024.

Portfolio route: https://calebstacy.com/#portals

## Positioning

Caleb is an experienced senior content designer first. Systems are one method he uses: when a
decision can be made repeatable, he turns it into guidance, an experiment, a deterministic check,
or a tool. He keeps contextual judgment with people when the available evidence does not determine
one answer.
